observer: Guermok USB2 HDMI capture dongle (/dev/video2), HPD held by a continuous streamer
notes: The dongle asserts HDMI HPD only while its UVC pipeline streams; a capture window that stops streaming lets the kernel drop EDID and the output goes blank (uniform 0,0,0 on decode). Frames here were captured with a persistent streamer.
Frames are the composited KMS scanout read back through the capture chain, not engine-side grabs.

frames.hud-idle.png: idle HUD: mode/scene/persist/fps, 5 knob sliders (light grey), MIDI grid, gain bar, stereo VU, FG/BG palette swatches
frames.hud-recording.png: knob sliders red while the sequencer records
frames.hud-playing.png: knob sliders green while the sequence plays; sequenced knob positions
frames.hud-trigger-tone.png: trigger held: synthesised tone drives the VU meters, trigger indicator filled yellow
frames.menu-palettes.png: Palettes screen: FG/BG gradient previews, indices, palette names
frames.menu-hardware-test-tone.png: Hardware test screen: pots PASS, buttons PASS, audio PASS with the synthesised tone, MIDI FAIL (no source attached)
frames.menu-hardware-test-before-diagnostics-wi: Hardware test screen on release dev-15807579b85e: pots/buttons/audio FAIL because the menu never observed live telemetry (fixed in dev-0fea6c253188)
